verdict.rationale: Pulumi's docs describe adoption/import of existing resources (pulumi-docs-6, pulumi-docs-17). Running `pulumi import` adds the resource to the stack's state and generates the code to manage it (pulumi-docs-25). `pulumi preview --import-file` supports bulk import workflows (pulumi-docs-21), and the docs also cover migrating from Terraform and CloudFormation (pulumi-docs-10). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of import and code-generation quality; the generated code must be copied into the program by hand rather than written in place.
